description: A photograph depicting a dirt track running parallel to a calm body of water, likely a highly modified natural water course or an artificial water course (canal). The track is unpaved, with patches of green grass in the middle and along its edges. To the left, a dense line of trees forms a green backdrop. To the right, the water body is lined by tall green grass on its bank. In the distance, a bridge or similar structure spans the water. The image is copyrighted "©European Union 2012" and sourced from "LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey).
